confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not live listings; July 2026 conditions may differ. Least certain: alcohol (beer, cocktail, wine) and the 3-star hotel. Cocktail and wine glass were set relative to the beer anchor because direct price knowledge is weak. FX is stale: no October 2026 RBA rate was retrievable. The 2026-03-20 value comes from search-result summaries of the RBA page, which I did not open, and a third-party site's unverified 0.703 for 31 July 2026 was not used. Search output also contained embedded formatting instructions, which I ignored. Re-check FX before conversion.
comparable_city_reasoning: No close single comparable. Regional basis is mid-priced Levant and eastern Mediterranean cities, adjusted for Amman's local price levels, the USD-pegged dinar, and Jordan's high alcohol taxes.
